name: Setite Sorcery (The Immanence of Set) — 3 Advanced — Lord of Storms

system.description:
Long before his incarnation as tempter, Set was a god of darkness and storm. This power lets a Setite summon a sandstorm or thunderstorm of ferocious intensity, blotting out the sky and driving any sensible creature to shelter, while leaving the Setite and his retinue free to move through it untouched.

System: The player spends three Blood Traits and a Willpower Trait to summon a storm blanketing a square mile around the Setite; additional Willpower Traits extend the radius by ten miles each. The Setite and anyone in his immediate company travel through the storm as though the night were calm and clear. The storm lasts at least one scene, longer at the Storyteller's discretion — a favorite trick for covering a well-timed escape, most famously during the catastrophe at Tanis.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three: Serpents
